lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical lines of high contrast; spacing is narrowest at the anterior (shoulder) and progressively widens toward the posterior (flank).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 3rd vertical line from the anterior, positioned approximately 25% down from the dorsal ridge; a second minor split occurs on the 10th line in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 4 is fragmented/dashed in the mid-lateral section; lines 1, 2, 11, and 12 terminate before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 7 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, concentrated above the hind leg joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb exhibit horizontal alignment, creating a short geometric line parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; two distinct white patches on the lower throat/neck area; white banding present above the dark hooves on all visible limbs.
